sentences.sentence_en: What's up? Long time no see!
sentences.sentence_cn: 怎么了？好久不见啦！

sentences.sentence_en: How are you doing today?
sentences.sentence_cn: 你今天过得怎么样？

sentences.sentence_en: I couldn't be better, thanks for asking.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我再好不过了，谢谢你的关心。

sentences.sentence_en: Have a wonderful weekend ahead!
sentences.sentence_cn: 祝你度过一个愉快的周末！

sentences.sentence_en: I completely agree with your point.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我完全同意你的观点。

sentences.sentence_en: I'm afraid I have a different opinion.
sentences.sentence_cn: 恐怕我有不太一样的看法。

sentences.sentence_en: That sounds like a fair deal to me.
sentences.sentence_cn: 在我看来这挺公平合理的。

sentences.sentence_en: Let me think about it and get back to you.
sentences.sentence_cn: 让我考虑一下，回头再回复你。

sentences.sentence_en: Could you please do me a favor?
sentences.sentence_cn: 你能帮我一个忙吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Would you mind closing the window?
sentences.sentence_cn: 你介意把窗户关上吗？

sentences.sentence_en: I would really appreciate your assistance.
sentences.sentence_cn: 若能得到你的协助我将不胜感激。

sentences.sentence_en: Feel free to let me know if you need anything.
sentences.sentence_cn: 如果你需要任何帮助，请随时告诉我。

sentences.sentence_en: Thank you so much for your kind help.
sentences.sentence_cn: 非常感谢你热心的帮助。

sentences.sentence_en: Don't mention it, that's what friends are for.
sentences.sentence_cn: 别客气，朋友之间本该如此。

sentences.sentence_en: I am terribly sorry for keeping you waiting.
sentences.sentence_cn: 让你久等了，我感到非常抱歉。

sentences.sentence_en: It was entirely my fault, please forgive me.
sentences.sentence_cn: 这完全是我的疏忽，请原谅我。

sentences.sentence_en: You have got to be kidding me!
sentences.sentence_cn: 你一定是在跟我开玩笑吧！

sentences.sentence_en: That is absolutely fantastic news!
sentences.sentence_cn: 那简直是一个天大的好消息！

sentences.sentence_en: What a coincidence to bump into you here!
sentences.sentence_cn: 真巧啊，竟然在这里碰到你！

sentences.sentence_en: No wonder everyone speaks so highly of it.
sentences.sentence_cn: 难怪大家都对它评价这么高。

sentences.sentence_en: Excuse me, how do I get to the nearest station?
sentences.sentence_cn: 打扰一下，请问去最近的地铁站怎么走？

sentences.sentence_en: Go straight for two blocks and turn left.
sentences.sentence_cn: 直走穿过两个街区，然后向左转。

sentences.sentence_en: Is it within walking distance from here?
sentences.sentence_cn: 从这里走着过去能到吗？

sentences.sentence_en: You won't miss it, it's right opposite the bank.
sentences.sentence_cn: 你不会错过的，它就在银行正对面。

sentences.sentence_en: Are you free this coming Friday afternoon?
sentences.sentence_cn: 这个星期五下午你有空吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Does three o'clock work well for you?
sentences.sentence_cn: 三点钟对你来说合适吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Something came up, can we reschedule?
sentences.sentence_cn: 我临时有点急事，我们能改期吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Let's lock in ten o'clock tomorrow morning.
sentences.sentence_cn: 那我们就定在明天上午十点整吧。

sentences.sentence_en: May I speak to Mr. Johnson, please?
sentences.sentence_cn: 请问我可以和约翰逊先生通话吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Hold on a second, I will put you through.
sentences.sentence_cn: 请稍等片刻，我这就为您转接。

sentences.sentence_en: He is tied up right now, would you like to leave a message?
sentences.sentence_cn: 他现在正忙，您需要留个口信吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Could you ask him to call me back as soon as possible?
sentences.sentence_cn: 能否请他尽快给我回个电话？

sentences.sentence_en: It looks like it is going to rain soon.
sentences.sentence_cn: 看天色好像马上就要下雨了。

sentences.sentence_en: The weather is lovely today, isn't it?
sentences.sentence_cn: 今天天气真不错，不是吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Don't forget to take an umbrella just in case.
sentences.sentence_cn: 带把雨伞吧，以防万一。

sentences.sentence_en: I love autumn because the breeze is so refreshing.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我喜欢秋天，因为秋风让人感到心旷神怡。

sentences.sentence_en: It was really great catching up with you.
sentences.sentence_cn: 今天能和你聚聚聊聊真是太棒了。

sentences.sentence_en: Take care and keep in touch!
sentences.sentence_cn: 多保重，常保持联系！

sentences.sentence_en: Drop me a line whenever you arrive.
sentences.sentence_cn: 你一到那里就给我发个消息。

sentences.sentence_en: See you next time, have a safe trip home!
sentences.sentence_cn: 下次见，路上注意安全！

sentences.sentence_en: Good morning! Time to wake up and start a new day.
sentences.sentence_cn: 早上好！该起床开始新的一天了。

sentences.sentence_en: I need to brush my teeth and wash my face.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我要去刷牙和洗脸。

sentences.sentence_en: My alarm went off ten minutes ago.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我的闹钟十分钟前就响过了。

sentences.sentence_en: A cup of hot coffee always wakes me up.
sentences.sentence_cn: 一杯热咖啡总能让我瞬间清醒。

sentences.sentence_en: What are we having for breakfast today?
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们今天早餐吃什么呢？

sentences.sentence_en: I would like some toasted bread with fried eggs.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我想吃烤面包配煎蛋。

sentences.sentence_en: Please pass me the strawberry jam.
sentences.sentence_cn: 请把草莓果酱递给我一下。

sentences.sentence_en: Eat slowly, you still have plenty of time.
sentences.sentence_cn: 慢慢吃，你还有充裕的时间。

sentences.sentence_en: What should I wear for today's weather?
sentences.sentence_cn: 针对今天的天气我该穿什么好呢？

sentences.sentence_en: Put on your warm jacket, it is chilly outside.
sentences.sentence_cn: 穿上你的保暖外套，外面有点凉。

sentences.sentence_en: These comfortable sneakers match your blue jeans.
sentences.sentence_cn: 这双舒适的运动鞋和你的牛仔裤很搭。

sentences.sentence_en: Where did I put my car keys and wallet?
sentences.sentence_cn: 我把我的车钥匙和钱包放哪儿了？

sentences.sentence_en: I usually take the subway to work every morning.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我通常每天早上乘地铁去上班。

sentences.sentence_en: The train is quite crowded during rush hour.
sentences.sentence_cn: 在上下班高峰期地铁里非常拥挤。

sentences.sentence_en: Please swipe your transit card at the turnstile.
sentences.sentence_cn: 请在闸机处刷一下您的交通卡。

sentences.sentence_en: We will arrive at our destination in three stops.
sentences.sentence_cn: 再过三站我们就会到达目的地了。

sentences.sentence_en: Let us grab a shopping cart near the entrance.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们去入口附近推一辆购物车吧。

sentences.sentence_en: These red apples are very fresh and on sale.
sentences.sentence_cn: 这些红苹果很新鲜而且正在打折。

sentences.sentence_en: We need to buy some milk, eggs and whole wheat bread.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们需要买些牛奶、鸡蛋和全麦面包。

sentences.sentence_en: How much is this bottle of olive oil?
sentences.sentence_cn: 这瓶橄榄油售价多少钱？

sentences.sentence_en: Could you please help me chop the fresh vegetables?
sentences.sentence_cn: 你能帮我把这些新鲜蔬菜切一下吗？

sentences.sentence_en: The beef stew smells absolutely delicious.
sentences.sentence_cn: 这锅炖牛肉闻起来真是香气扑鼻。

sentences.sentence_en: Be careful with the hot stove and boiling soup.
sentences.sentence_cn: 小心烫手的炉灶和滚沸的汤。

sentences.sentence_en: Dinner is finally ready, come and sit down!
sentences.sentence_cn: 晚餐终于做好了，快过来坐下吃吧！

sentences.sentence_en: I will do the dishes if you sweep the floor.
sentences.sentence_cn: 如果你扫地的话，我就去洗碗。

sentences.sentence_en: Remember to take out the trash before going to bed.
sentences.sentence_cn: 睡觉前记得把垃圾袋带出去扔掉。

sentences.sentence_en: The living room looks neat and tidy now.
sentences.sentence_cn: 现在客厅看起来干净整洁多了。

sentences.sentence_en: Let us fold the clean laundry together.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们一起来把洗干净的衣服叠好吧。

sentences.sentence_en: I love reading a book on the comfortable sofa.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我喜欢坐在舒适的沙发上读一本好书。

sentences.sentence_en: Do you want to watch an exciting movie tonight?
sentences.sentence_cn: 你今晚想看一部刺激精彩的电影吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Listening to soft music helps me unwind after work.
sentences.sentence_cn: 下班后听听轻柔的音乐有助于我放松身心。

sentences.sentence_en: Let us go for a relaxing walk in the park.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们去公园里散步轻松一下吧。

sentences.sentence_en: Taking a warm bath washes away all the tiredness.
sentences.sentence_cn: 泡个温水澡能把一整天的疲惫都洗去。

sentences.sentence_en: I set my phone on silent mode before bed.
sentences.sentence_cn: 睡前我把手机设置成了静音模式。

sentences.sentence_en: Don't forget to turn off the lights in the corridor.
sentences.sentence_cn: 别忘了把走廊上的灯随手关掉。

sentences.sentence_en: Make sure all the doors and windows are securely locked.
sentences.sentence_cn: 确保门窗都已经被安全锁好。

sentences.sentence_en: It has been a long day, I am ready to sleep.
sentences.sentence_cn: 今天过得很充实漫长，我准备入睡了。

sentences.sentence_en: Good night and sleep tight, sweet dreams!
sentences.sentence_cn: 晚安，好好睡个安稳觉，做个好梦！

sentences.sentence_en: See you bright and early tomorrow morning.
sentences.sentence_cn: 明天一早我们再见。

sentences.sentence_en: Rest well, tomorrow will be another great day.
sentences.sentence_cn: 好好休息，明天又将是美好的一天。

sentences.sentence_en: Here are my passport and flight booking confirmation.
sentences.sentence_cn: 这是我的护照和机票预订确认单。

sentences.sentence_en: Would you prefer a window seat or an aisle seat?
sentences.sentence_cn: 您更想要靠窗的座位还是靠过道的座位？

sentences.sentence_en: How many pieces of luggage are you checking in today?
sentences.sentence_cn: 您今天有几件行李需要办理托运？

sentences.sentence_en: Here is your boarding pass, boarding starts at gate twelve.
sentences.sentence_cn: 这是您的登机牌，将在12号登机口开始登机。

sentences.sentence_en: Please place your suitcase onto the electronic scale.
sentences.sentence_cn: 请将您的行李箱放到电子秤上。

sentences.sentence_en: Is there any fragile or flammable item inside?
sentences.sentence_cn: 里面有任何易碎品或易燃易爆物品吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Your bag is two kilograms overweight, an extra fee applies.
sentences.sentence_cn: 您的行李超重了两公斤，需要支付额外费用。

sentences.sentence_en: Can I transfer some items into my carry-on bag?
sentences.sentence_cn: 我可以把部分物品挪到我的手提行李里吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Please take out your laptop and liquids from your bag.
sentences.sentence_cn: 请将笔记本电脑和液体物品从包里取出来。

sentences.sentence_en: Remove your coat, belt and empty all your pockets.
sentences.sentence_cn: 请脱掉外套、解下皮带并掏空所有口袋。

sentences.sentence_en: Please step through the metal detector one by one.
sentences.sentence_cn: 请依次穿过金属探测安检门。

sentences.sentence_en: You are all clear, collect your belongings over there.
sentences.sentence_cn: 您已经通过检查了，请去那边取回您的物品。

sentences.sentence_en: Flight CA981 is now boarding through gate B24.
sentences.sentence_cn: CA981次航班现在开始在B24登机口登机。

sentences.sentence_en: Please have your passport and boarding pass ready.
sentences.sentence_cn: 请提前准备好您的护照和登机牌。

sentences.sentence_en: We are currently inviting passengers with small children to board.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们目前优先邀请带小孩的乘客登机。

sentences.sentence_en: The departure has been delayed due to bad weather.
sentences.sentence_cn: 由于恶劣天气原因，航班起飞时间有所延误。

sentences.sentence_en: Would you like chicken with rice or beef pasta?
sentences.sentence_cn: 您想要鸡肉饭还是牛肉意面？

sentences.sentence_en: Could I have a cup of warm water without ice, please?
sentences.sentence_cn: 请给我一杯不加冰的温水好吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Could you provide me with an extra blanket and a pillow?
sentences.sentence_cn: 能额外给我提供一条毛毯和一个枕头吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Please fasten your seatbelt, we are experiencing turbulence.
sentences.sentence_cn: 请系好安全带，我们正在遭遇颠簸气流。

sentences.sentence_en: What is the primary purpose of your visit to our country?
sentences.sentence_cn: 您来我国的主要目的是什么？

sentences.sentence_en: I am here on vacation for ten days with my family.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我是和家人一起来这里度假旅游十天的。

sentences.sentence_en: Where will you be staying during your visit?
sentences.sentence_cn: 在您逗留期间您会住在哪里？

sentences.sentence_en: Welcome to Canada, have an enjoyable stay!
sentences.sentence_cn: 欢迎来到加拿大，祝您旅途愉快！

sentences.sentence_en: Which carousel is handling the luggage from flight NH106?
sentences.sentence_cn: NH106次航班的行李在几号行李转盘提取？

sentences.sentence_en: My black suitcase hasn't come out yet.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我的黑色行李箱到现在还没有出来。

sentences.sentence_en: I would like to file a missing baggage claim report.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我想填报一份行李遗失索赔报告单。

sentences.sentence_en: We will deliver your luggage directly to your hotel once found.
sentences.sentence_cn: 一旦找到您的行李，我们会直接送至您下榻的酒店。

sentences.sentence_en: Where can I find the nearest foreign currency exchange counter?
sentences.sentence_cn: 请问哪里能找到最近的外币兑换柜台？

sentences.sentence_en: What is today's exchange rate from US dollars to Euros?
sentences.sentence_cn: 今天美元兑换欧元的汇率是多少？

sentences.sentence_en: Does this ATM accept international UnionPay cards?
sentences.sentence_cn: 这台自动取款机支持国际银联卡吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Could you give me some smaller bills and loose coins?
sentences.sentence_cn: 你能给我一些小面额纸币和零钱硬币吗？

sentences.sentence_en: How can I get to the city center from the airport?
sentences.sentence_cn: 我该如何从机场前往市中心呢？

sentences.sentence_en: The Airport Express train runs every ten minutes.
sentences.sentence_cn: 机场快线列车每十分钟就有一班。

sentences.sentence_en: Where is the designated taxi pick-up line located?
sentences.sentence_cn: 指定的出租车排队等候点设在哪里？

sentences.sentence_en: Please take me to the Hilton Hotel on Fifth Avenue.
sentences.sentence_cn: 请带我去第五大道的希尔顿酒店。

sentences.sentence_en: Do you sell prepaid data SIM cards for tourists?
sentences.sentence_cn: 你们出售适合游客使用的预付费流量电话卡吗？

sentences.sentence_en: I need an unlimited high-speed data package for two weeks.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我需要一个为期两周的无限高速流量套餐。

sentences.sentence_en: Does this plan include international outgoing phone calls?
sentences.sentence_cn: 这个套餐包含拨打国际长途电话吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Could you please help me install and activate the SIM card?
sentences.sentence_cn: 你能帮我安装并激活这张电话卡吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Good afternoon, I have a reservation under the name of Smith.
sentences.sentence_cn: 下午好，我有预订，登记的名字是史密斯。

sentences.sentence_en: May I have your credit card for the incidental deposit?
sentences.sentence_cn: 请出示您的信用卡以预授权杂费押金。

sentences.sentence_en: Your room is on the eighth floor with an ocean view.
sentences.sentence_cn: 您的客房在8楼，是一间海景房。

sentences.sentence_en: Breakfast is served from seven to ten at the ground floor cafe.
sentences.sentence_cn: 早餐时间是早上七点到十点，在一楼咖啡厅供应。

sentences.sentence_en: Is it possible to get a non-smoking room on a higher floor?
sentences.sentence_cn: 有可能换到高楼层的无烟房间吗？

sentences.sentence_en: We are celebrating our anniversary, can we get an upgrade?
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们正在庆祝结婚纪念日，能申请房型升级吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Could we please request two separate twin beds instead?
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们能否换成两张独立的双胞胎单人床呢？

sentences.sentence_en: We are happy to offer you a complimentary suite upgrade today.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们今天非常荣幸为您提供免费套房升级服务。

sentences.sentence_en: What are the operating hours for the heated swimming pool?
sentences.sentence_cn: 温水恒温游泳池的开放时间是几点到几点？

sentences.sentence_en: Is the fitness center free of charge for in-house guests?
sentences.sentence_cn: 住店客人使用健身房是免费的吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Where is the executive business lounge located?
sentences.sentence_cn: 行政商务酒廊位于几楼？

sentences.sentence_en: Do you offer dry cleaning and laundry services here?
sentences.sentence_cn: 你们这里提供干洗和洗衣服务吗？

sentences.sentence_en: I would like to order room service for dinner, please.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我想点一份客房送餐晚餐。

sentences.sentence_en: Could you send someone up with fresh towels and bathrobes?
sentences.sentence_cn: 能派人送一些干净的毛巾和浴袍上来吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Please don't disturb us before noon tomorrow.
sentences.sentence_cn: 明天中午之前请不要打扰我们。

sentences.sentence_en: Could you arrange for our room to be cleaned right now?
sentences.sentence_cn: 现在可以安排保洁人员打扫一下我们的房间吗？

sentences.sentence_en: The air conditioning unit in our room isn't cooling properly.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们房间的空调制冷好像不太正常。

sentences.sentence_en: There seems to be no hot water running in the bathroom.
sentences.sentence_cn: 浴室里好像一直没有流出热水。

sentences.sentence_en: The Wi-Fi connection keeps dropping every few minutes.
sentences.sentence_cn: 无线网络每隔几分钟就会断开一次。

sentences.sentence_en: We will send a technician up immediately to fix the issue.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们马上派一名维修工程师上去为您解决问题。

sentences.sentence_en: Could you recommend some authentic local restaurants nearby?
sentences.sentence_cn: 能推荐几家附近地道的当地特色餐厅吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Can you help us book four tickets for tonight's Broadway show?
sentences.sentence_cn: 能帮我们预订今晚百老汇演出的四张门票吗？

sentences.sentence_en: What is the best way to travel to the historic old town?
sentences.sentence_cn: 去历史老城区最便捷的出行方式是什么？

sentences.sentence_en: Here is a complimentary tourist city map for your convenience.
sentences.sentence_cn: 这是一份免费的城市旅游地图，方便您的出行。

sentences.sentence_en: Can we store our heavy luggage here after check-out?
sentences.sentence_cn: 退房后我们可以把笨重的行李寄存在这里吗？

sentences.sentence_en: We will return to collect our bags around five in the evening.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们大约会在傍晚五点左右回来取行李。

sentences.sentence_en: Here is your baggage claim tag, please keep it safe.
sentences.sentence_cn: 这是您的行李寄存牌，请妥善保管。

sentences.sentence_en: Is overnight parking complimentary for registered hotel guests?
sentences.sentence_cn: 住店登记客人过夜停车是免费的吗？

sentences.sentence_en: We love this place, is it possible to extend our stay for two nights?
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们很喜欢这里，有可能再续住两晚吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Could we request a complimentary late check-out until two p.m.?
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们能申请延迟退房到下午两点吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Let me check our room availability for those additional dates.
sentences.sentence_cn: 让我为您查询一下那几天的客房空余情况。

sentences.sentence_en: You may keep your room key until one o'clock tomorrow.
sentences.sentence_cn: 您可以一直保留房间钥匙直到明天一点。

sentences.sentence_en: Good morning, we are checking out of room 806.
sentences.sentence_cn: 早上好，我们办理806房间的退房手续。

sentences.sentence_en: Did you consume anything from the in-room mini-bar?
sentences.sentence_cn: 您有消费房间迷你吧里的饮品或零食吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Could you please explain this additional charge on the invoice?
sentences.sentence_cn: 您能解释一下发票上这项额外的收费明细吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Everything looks accurate, I will settle the bill with this card.
sentences.sentence_cn: 账单都核对准确了，我刷这张卡结清余款。

sentences.sentence_en: Could you call a spacious taxi to take us to the airport?
sentences.sentence_cn: 能帮我们叫一辆宽敞的出租车去机场吗？

sentences.sentence_en: The driver is waiting outside the main entrance.
sentences.sentence_cn: 司机已经在酒店正门外等候您了。

sentences.sentence_en: Thank you for staying with us, we hope to see you again soon!
sentences.sentence_cn: 感谢您选择入住我们酒店，期待不久能再次光临！

sentences.sentence_en: We had a wonderful time here, thank you for the hospitality!
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们在这里度过了美妙的时光，感谢你们周到的款待！

sentences.sentence_en: I would like to book a table for two tonight at seven.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我想预订今晚七点两人用餐的桌位。

sentences.sentence_en: Do you have a quiet table available by the window?
sentences.sentence_cn: 你们靠窗位置有安静的空桌吗？

sentences.sentence_en: We have a reservation under David, party of four.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们有预订，登记名是大卫，一共四位。

sentences.sentence_en: Right this way, please follow me to your table.
sentences.sentence_cn: 请这边走，请随我前往您的餐桌。

sentences.sentence_en: Can we start off with some sparkling water with lemon?
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们可以先来点加柠檬片的气泡水吗？

sentences.sentence_en: What would you recommend for light appetizers?
sentences.sentence_cn: 对于清淡开胃的前菜，您有什么推荐吗？

sentences.sentence_en: We will have the smoked salmon and garlic bread, please.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们想要烟熏三文鱼配香蒜烤面包。

sentences.sentence_en: Would you like to review our wine pairing list?
sentences.sentence_cn: 您想看一下我们的佐餐葡萄酒搭配单吗？

sentences.sentence_en: I will have the ribeye steak with mashed potatoes.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我要一份肋眼牛排配特制土豆泥。

sentences.sentence_en: How would you like your prime steak cooked tonight?
sentences.sentence_cn: 您今晚的牛排想要几分熟？

sentences.sentence_en: Medium rare, please, with black pepper sauce on the side.
sentences.sentence_cn: 请帮我做成五分熟，黑胡椒汁单独放在旁边。

sentences.sentence_en: What kind of dressing would you like on your garden salad?
sentences.sentence_cn: 您的田园沙拉想要搭配哪种风味的沙拉酱？

sentences.sentence_en: Is this cream soup completely gluten-free?
sentences.sentence_cn: 这款奶油浓汤完全不含麸质吗？

sentences.sentence_en: I am severely allergic to peanuts and shellfish.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我对花生和贝类海鲜严重过敏。

sentences.sentence_en: Do you have any vegetarian or vegan main dishes?
sentences.sentence_cn: 你们菜单上有蛋奶素或纯素食主菜吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Please make sure there is no added dairy in this dish.
sentences.sentence_cn: 请务必确保这道菜品中没有添加任何乳制品。

sentences.sentence_en: Excuse me, could we get some extra napkins and forks?
sentences.sentence_cn: 打扰一下，能帮我们添几张餐巾纸和叉子吗？

sentences.sentence_en: How is everything tasting so far, folks?
sentences.sentence_cn: 各位，目前上桌的菜品味道感觉如何？

sentences.sentence_en: Everything is cooked to perfection, absolutely delicious!
sentences.sentence_cn: 每一道菜都烹饪得恰到好处，非常美味！

sentences.sentence_en: Could you please refill our glasses with ice water?
sentences.sentence_cn: 能帮我们的杯子添点冰水吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Are you ready to explore our dessert menu now?
sentences.sentence_cn: 您现在准备好看看我们的甜点单了吗？

sentences.sentence_en: The classic Italian tiramisu is our chef's specialty.
sentences.sentence_cn: 这款经典意式提拉米苏是我们主厨的招牌拿手好戏。

sentences.sentence_en: I would like a double espresso and a scoop of vanilla ice cream.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我想要一杯双份浓缩咖啡配一个香草冰淇淋球。

sentences.sentence_en: Can we share one slice of chocolate lava cake?
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们两个人能共享一份熔岩巧克力蛋糕吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Excuse me, I believe I ordered the grilled salmon, not chicken.
sentences.sentence_cn: 打扰一下，我记得我点的是香煎三文鱼而不是鸡肉。

sentences.sentence_en: Could you please check on our pasta? We have been waiting for a while.
sentences.sentence_cn: 能帮我们催一下意面吗？我们已经等了好一会儿了。

sentences.sentence_en: This soup has gone cold, could you warm it up for me?
sentences.sentence_cn: 这碗汤已经凉了，能帮我重新加热一下吗？

sentences.sentence_en: We sincerely apologize, I will replace this dish right away.
sentences.sentence_cn: 实在非常抱歉，我这就立刻去为您更换这道菜。

sentences.sentence_en: Could we have the check, please, whenever you are ready?
sentences.sentence_cn: 方便的话请帮我们拿一下账单好吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Do you accept international credit cards and Apple Pay?
sentences.sentence_cn: 你们支持国际信用卡和苹果移动支付吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Can we split the bill evenly between the two of us?
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们两个人能平摊账单各付一半吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Is the service charge already included in this total?
sentences.sentence_cn: 服务费已经包含在这个总金额里了吗？

sentences.sentence_en: A standard tip of fifteen to twenty percent is customary here.
sentences.sentence_cn: 在这里通常给百分之十五到二十的小费是合乎礼仪的惯例。

sentences.sentence_en: Keep the change, the service was truly exceptional tonight.
sentences.sentence_cn: 零钱不用找了，今晚的服务真的很周到出色。

sentences.sentence_en: You can add an eighteen percent gratuity directly on the terminal.
sentences.sentence_cn: 您可以直接在刷卡机终端上选择百分之十八的小费。

sentences.sentence_en: Thank you for the generous tip, have a good night!
sentences.sentence_cn: 非常感谢您慷慨的小费，祝您夜晚愉快！

sentences.sentence_en: Could you wrap up the rest of the steak for takeout?
sentences.sentence_cn: 能把剩下的牛排帮我打包外带吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Can I have a to-go box and a paper bag, please?
sentences.sentence_cn: 请给我一个外卖打包盒和一个纸袋好吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Everything was wonderful, we will definitely visit again.
sentences.sentence_cn: 所有的菜品都很美妙，我们一定会再次光顾的。

sentences.sentence_en: Thank you for dining with us, have a safe trip back!
sentences.sentence_cn: 感谢您在我们餐厅用餐，路上注意安全！

sentences.sentence_en: I am just looking around for now, thank you.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我目前只是随便看看，谢谢你。

sentences.sentence_en: Excuse me, where can I find the women's shoe department?
sentences.sentence_cn: 打扰一下，请问女鞋专柜在几楼？

sentences.sentence_en: Do you have this stylish leather jacket in my size?
sentences.sentence_cn: 这款时尚皮夹克有适合我的尺码吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Can you help me reach that bag displayed on the top shelf?
sentences.sentence_cn: 能帮我拿一下顶层陈列架上的那个包吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Where are the fitting rooms located in this store?
sentences.sentence_cn: 请问这家店的试衣间设在什么位置？

sentences.sentence_en: Can I try this winter sweater on in size medium?
sentences.sentence_cn: 我可以试穿一下这件中号冬装毛衣吗？

sentences.sentence_en: This pair of trousers is a bit too tight around the waist.
sentences.sentence_cn: 这条裤子的腰围部分感觉有点太紧了。

sentences.sentence_en: Do you have this design in a larger or looser size?
sentences.sentence_cn: 这个款式你们有更大或者更宽松的尺码吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Does this wool coat come in navy blue or beige?
sentences.sentence_cn: 这款羊毛大衣有藏青色或米色款吗？

sentences.sentence_en: This bright color looks really flattering on you.
sentences.sentence_cn: 这种鲜亮的颜色穿在你身上显得特别衬肤色。

sentences.sentence_en: Is this genuine leather or synthetic material?
sentences.sentence_cn: 这是纯真皮材质还是人造合成面料？

sentences.sentence_en: Do you have any other casual styles similar to this one?
sentences.sentence_cn: 你们还有类似这种风格的其他休闲款式吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Is there any ongoing promotion or seasonal discount on this?
sentences.sentence_cn: 这款商品目前有任何促销优惠或季节折扣吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Buy one and get the second one at fifty percent off.
sentences.sentence_cn: 买一件，第二件享受半价五折优惠。

sentences.sentence_en: Does this marked price include the local sales tax?
sentences.sentence_cn: 这个标牌价格已经包含当地消费税了吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Can I get an extra discount if I sign up for membership?
sentences.sentence_cn: 如果我注册会员能享受额外折扣吗？

sentences.sentence_en: I would like to purchase these three items, please.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我想买下这三件商品，请帮我结账。

sentences.sentence_en: Would you like a shopping bag with handles?
sentences.sentence_cn: 您需要一个带提手的购物袋吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Can you gift wrap this perfume for a birthday present?
sentences.sentence_cn: 能帮我把这瓶香水作为生日礼物包装一下吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Please insert or tap your chip card on the reader.
sentences.sentence_cn: 请将您的芯片卡插入或轻触感应读卡器。

sentences.sentence_en: Is this boutique eligible for tax-free shopping for tourists?
sentences.sentence_cn: 这家精品店支持外国游客免税购物吗？

sentences.sentence_en: What is the minimum spending amount to claim a tax refund?
sentences.sentence_cn: 申请退税的最低消费门槛金额是多少？

sentences.sentence_en: Could you please issue a tax refund form with my purchase?
sentences.sentence_cn: 购物后能为我开具一份退税申请单吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Please present your original passport and boarding pass.
sentences.sentence_cn: 请出示您的护照原件和登机牌。

sentences.sentence_en: Where is the airport customs desk for the tax-free stamp?
sentences.sentence_cn: 请问机场海关敲免税核验章的柜台在哪里？

sentences.sentence_en: Do I need to show the purchased goods to the customs officer?
sentences.sentence_cn: 我需要向海关官员出示展示所购商品实物吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Would you prefer your tax refund in cash or back to your card?
sentences.sentence_cn: 您的退税款想退现金还是退回您的信用卡？

sentences.sentence_en: The refunded amount will be credited within three weeks.
sentences.sentence_cn: 退税款项将在三个工作周内到账。

sentences.sentence_en: I would like to exchange this shirt for a smaller size.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我想把这件衬衫换成稍微小一点的尺码。

sentences.sentence_en: I have the original purchase receipt and the tags are still attached.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我带了原始购物收据，而且商品吊牌完好无损。

sentences.sentence_en: Can I get a full refund back to my original payment method?
sentences.sentence_cn: 能把全额退款退回到我的原支付账户中吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Our store policy allows returns within thirty days of purchase.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们商场的规定支持在购买后三十天内办理退货。

sentences.sentence_en: I noticed a zipper defect when I opened the box at home.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我回家开箱后发现这个拉链存在做工瑕疵。

sentences.sentence_en: Does this electronic gadget come with an international warranty?
sentences.sentence_cn: 这款电子产品附带全球联保保修服务吗？

sentences.sentence_en: We can replace it with a brand new sealed one right now.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们现在就可以为您换一个全新未拆封的同款产品。

sentences.sentence_en: Please keep your receipt as valid proof of warranty.
sentences.sentence_cn: 请妥善保管好您的购物小票作为有效的保修凭据。

sentences.sentence_en: Does this high-speed charger support dual universal voltage?
sentences.sentence_cn: 这款快速充电器支持全球宽幅通用电压吗？

sentences.sentence_en: I need a travel power plug adapter for UK wall sockets.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我需要一个适用于英标墙壁插座的旅行转换插头。

sentences.sentence_en: How many hours does the battery typically last on a single charge?
sentences.sentence_cn: 充满一次电后电池通常能续航使用多少个小时？

sentences.sentence_en: This wireless noise-canceling headphone provides superior sound quality.
sentences.sentence_cn: 这款无线降噪耳机提供了极其出众的音质表现。

sentences.sentence_en: Wake up, sleepyhead! The warm sun is shining brightly.
sentences.sentence_cn: 小懒虫，该起床啦！温暖的太阳已经高高升起啦。

sentences.sentence_en: Give mommy a big morning hug and a sweet kiss.
sentences.sentence_cn: 给妈妈一个大大的早安拥抱和一个甜甜的亲亲吧。

sentences.sentence_en: Let's stretch our arms and legs together like a cat.
sentences.sentence_cn: 让我们像小猫一样一起伸伸小胳膊踢踢小腿吧。

sentences.sentence_en: Time to wash your little face and brush your teeth.
sentences.sentence_cn: 该去洗洗你的小脸蛋，认真刷牙啦。

sentences.sentence_en: Sit properly in your high chair, sweetie.
sentences.sentence_cn: 宝贝，在你的专属餐椅上坐好哦。

sentences.sentence_en: Blow on the warm oatmeal before taking a small bite.
sentences.sentence_cn: 吃温热的燕麦粥前先轻轻吹一吹再小口吃。

sentences.sentence_en: Chew your food slowly with your mouth closed.
sentences.sentence_cn: 闭着小嘴巴慢慢细细地咀嚼食物。

sentences.sentence_en: Would you like another small glass of fresh milk?
sentences.sentence_cn: 你想要再来一小杯新鲜牛奶吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Can you put your arms through these colorful sleeves?
sentences.sentence_cn: 你能把两只小手伸进这些彩色的衣袖里吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Look, your shoes are on the wrong feet, let's swap them.
sentences.sentence_cn: 看呀，你的鞋子穿反啦，我们换过来穿。

sentences.sentence_en: Pull up your socks and make sure you feel comfortable.
sentences.sentence_cn: 拉高你的袜子，确保脚脚觉得很舒服。

sentences.sentence_en: You did it all by yourself, what a big kid you are!
sentences.sentence_cn: 你全凭自己独立穿好了，真是个大孩子啦！

sentences.sentence_en: Hold on tight to the rails when you climb up the slide.
sentences.sentence_cn: 爬上滑梯的时候小手一定要抓紧两侧扶手。

sentences.sentence_en: Wait for your turn patiently and play nicely with friends.
sentences.sentence_cn: 要有耐心地排队轮流玩，和小伙伴们友善相处。

sentences.sentence_en: Don't run too fast on the uneven grass, be careful!
sentences.sentence_cn: 在不平整的草地上别跑太快，小心摔跤哦！

sentences.sentence_en: Drink some water to stay hydrated after running around.
sentences.sentence_cn: 跑跑跳跳后喝点水补充水分吧。

sentences.sentence_en: Playtime is over, let's clean up our toys together.
sentences.sentence_cn: 玩乐时间结束啦，我们一起来把玩具收拾好。

sentences.sentence_en: Put the wooden building blocks back into the storage box.
sentences.sentence_cn: 把这些木质积木一块块放回储物箱里。

sentences.sentence_en: Where does this soft teddy bear belong on the shelf?
sentences.sentence_cn: 这个软萌的小泰迪熊应该放在书架的哪一层呢？

sentences.sentence_en: Thank you for being such a wonderful little helper!
sentences.sentence_cn: 谢谢你做了一个这么棒的贴心小帮手！

sentences.sentence_en: Which bedtime fairy tale do you want to read tonight?
sentences.sentence_cn: 今晚你想读哪一本睡前童话故事书呀？

sentences.sentence_en: Look at the cheerful little rabbit hopping in the forest.
sentences.sentence_cn: 看这只欢快的小兔子在森林里蹦蹦跳跳。

sentences.sentence_en: What do you think will happen next on this page?
sentences.sentence_cn: 你猜猜看这一页接下来会发生什么有趣的事？

sentences.sentence_en: Once upon a time, in a magical castle far far away...
sentences.sentence_cn: 很久很久以前，在遥远的一座神奇城堡里……

sentences.sentence_en: I am so proud of your hard work and perseverance.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我真为你付出的努力和坚持不懈感到由衷自豪。

sentences.sentence_en: It is okay to feel sad or cry, mommy is always here for you.
sentences.sentence_cn: 难过或者想哭都没关系的，妈妈永远都在这里陪着你。

sentences.sentence_en: Take a deep breath and tell me what is bothering you.
sentences.sentence_cn: 深吸一口气，然后慢慢告诉我是什么让你不开心啦。

sentences.sentence_en: Mistakes help us learn and grow smarter every single day.
sentences.sentence_cn: 犯错误能帮助我们学到新本领，让我们每天都更聪明。

sentences.sentence_en: Remember to say please when you ask for something.
sentences.sentence_cn: 向别人要东西时记得礼貌地说一声‘请’哦。

sentences.sentence_en: Always say thank you when someone gives you a hand.
sentences.sentence_cn: 当有人伸出援手帮助你时，一定要真诚说‘谢谢’。

sentences.sentence_en: Sharing your favorite snacks makes everyone much happier.
sentences.sentence_cn: 分享你最喜爱的美味零食会让大家都更开心。

sentences.sentence_en: Say excuse me if you accidentally bump into someone.
sentences.sentence_cn: 如果不小心碰到了别人，要记得说‘不好意思’。

sentences.sentence_en: The warm bath water is ready with fluffy white bubbles.
sentences.sentence_cn: 温热的洗澡水放好啦，里面还有蓬松雪白的泡泡呢。

sentences.sentence_en: Close your eyes tight so the gentle shampoo won't sting.
sentences.sentence_cn: 把眼睛闭得紧紧的，温和的洗发水就不会辣眼睛啦。

sentences.sentence_en: Let's play with the floating yellow rubber duck.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们来和漂浮在水上的黄色小橡皮鸭一起玩吧。

sentences.sentence_en: Step onto the dry bath mat and wrap yourself in this towel.
sentences.sentence_cn: 踩在干燥的浴室地垫上，用这条大浴巾裹好身体。

sentences.sentence_en: Snuggle under your cozy blanket and close your tired eyes.
sentences.sentence_cn: 钻进暖和舒服的小被窝，闭上你困倦的小眼睛吧。

sentences.sentence_en: Twinkle twinkle little star, how I wonder what you are.
sentences.sentence_cn: 一闪一闪亮晶晶，满天都是小星星。

sentences.sentence_en: Mommy and daddy love you to the moon and back.
sentences.sentence_cn: 爸爸妈妈爱你胜过世间的一切。

sentences.sentence_en: Good night my precious angel, sweet dreams until sunrise.
sentences.sentence_cn: 晚安我最珍贵的小天使，做个美梦直到天亮。

sentences.sentence_en: Please send an ambulance immediately, someone collapsed here!
sentences.sentence_cn: 请立刻派一辆救护车来，这里有人晕倒了！

sentences.sentence_en: The patient is conscious but having severe chest pain.
sentences.sentence_cn: 伤者有意识，但正经历剧烈的胸痛。

sentences.sentence_en: Our exact location is 120 Market Street, near the fountain.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们的确切地址是市场街120号，喷泉旁边。

sentences.sentence_en: Stay on the phone with me, the paramedics are on their way.
sentences.sentence_cn: 请保持通话不要挂断，急救人员已经在全速赶往现场了。

sentences.sentence_en: I would like to register to see a general practitioner, please.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我想挂号看全科全诊医生。

sentences.sentence_en: Here is my passport and international travel health insurance.
sentences.sentence_cn: 这是我的护照和国际旅游医疗保险卡。

sentences.sentence_en: Please fill out this medical history and symptom questionnaire.
sentences.sentence_cn: 请填写这份既往病史与当前症状问卷表。

sentences.sentence_en: Please take a seat in the waiting area, doctor will call your name.
sentences.sentence_cn: 请在候诊区就座等候，医生会呼叫您的姓名。

sentences.sentence_en: I have been running a high fever and shivering since last night.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我从昨晚开始就一直发高烧并且浑身发冷打颤。

sentences.sentence_en: I have a throbbing headache and a sore throat.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我头一跳一跳地痛，而且喉咙很疼。

sentences.sentence_en: I feel dizzy, nauseous and my stomach hurts badly.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我感觉头晕目眩、恶心想吐，肚子也很难受。

sentences.sentence_en: How long have you been experiencing these persistent symptoms?
sentences.sentence_cn: 这些持续的症状你已经出现多长时间了？

sentences.sentence_en: Let me listen to your lungs with the stethoscope, take a deep breath.
sentences.sentence_cn: 让我用听诊器听听你的肺部，请深呼吸。

sentences.sentence_en: Your blood pressure is slightly elevated today at 135 over 85.
sentences.sentence_cn: 你今天的血压略微偏高，高压135低压85。

sentences.sentence_en: Open your mouth wide and say ah so I can inspect your throat.
sentences.sentence_cn: 请把嘴巴张大说‘啊’，让我检查一下你的咽喉部位。

sentences.sentence_en: Does it hurt when I gently press down on your lower abdomen?
sentences.sentence_cn: 当我轻轻按压你的下腹部时有痛感吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Are you allergic to penicillin or any other antibiotics?
sentences.sentence_cn: 你对青霉素或其他任何抗生素药物过敏吗？

sentences.sentence_en: I have a known mild allergy to sulfa drugs and aspirin.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我对磺胺类药物和阿司匹林有已知的轻度过敏反应。

sentences.sentence_en: Are you currently taking any prescription daily medications?
sentences.sentence_cn: 你目前平时有在规律服用任何处方药物吗？

sentences.sentence_en: I only take regular vitamin C and daily blood pressure pills.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我平时只服用常规的维生素C和降血压药片。

sentences.sentence_en: We need to take an X-ray of your ankle to rule out a fracture.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们需要为你脚踝拍一张X光片以排除骨折可能性。

sentences.sentence_en: Please roll up your left sleeve for a routine blood test.
sentences.sentence_cn: 请挽起你的左侧衣袖做一项常规血液化验。

sentences.sentence_en: The blood test results will be ready in approximately an hour.
sentences.sentence_cn: 验血报告结果大约会在一个小时之后出来。

sentences.sentence_en: You don't need to fast for this specific ultrasound scan.
sentences.sentence_cn: 这项腹部B超检查不需要提前空腹禁食。

sentences.sentence_en: You have a viral upper respiratory tract infection.
sentences.sentence_cn: 您患的是病毒性上呼吸道感染。

sentences.sentence_en: The X-ray shows no broken bones, just a bad ligament sprain.
sentences.sentence_cn: X光显示骨骼没有断裂，只是一次较严重的韧带扭伤。

sentences.sentence_en: You need plenty of bed rest and drink abundant warm water.
sentences.sentence_cn: 您需要多卧床休息并补充足量温水。

sentences.sentence_en: Avoid strenuous exercise and heavy lifting for at least two weeks.
sentences.sentence_cn: 在接下来的至少两周内避免剧烈运动和搬抬重物。

sentences.sentence_en: I have a prescription from Dr. Miller to fill today.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我有一份米勒医生开具的处方单需要拿药。

sentences.sentence_en: Take two tablets three times a day after meals with water.
sentences.sentence_cn: 每次饭后温水送服两片，每天服用三次。

sentences.sentence_en: This cough syrup may cause mild drowsiness, do not drive.
sentences.sentence_cn: 这款止咳糖浆可能会引起轻微嗜睡，服药后切勿开车。

sentences.sentence_en: Finish the entire course of antibiotics even if you feel better.
sentences.sentence_cn: 哪怕感觉好转了，也请务必吃完整个疗程的抗生素。

sentences.sentence_en: My back molar hurts terribly whenever I drink cold water.
sentences.sentence_cn: 每当我喝冷水时，我后面的那颗大臼齿就剧痛难忍。

sentences.sentence_en: A piece of my tooth chipped off while eating hard food.
sentences.sentence_cn: 吃硬东西时我的一颗牙齿被崩掉了一小块。

sentences.sentence_en: We will apply a local anesthetic before cleaning the decay.
sentences.sentence_cn: 在清理蛀牙腐质之前，我们会为您先施打局部麻醉。

sentences.sentence_en: Don't eat anything solid until the numbness wears off completely.
sentences.sentence_cn: 在麻药彻底消退之前，先不要咀嚼任何固体食物。

sentences.sentence_en: Could you provide an itemized medical bill and receipt for insurance?
sentences.sentence_cn: 能开具一份详细的医疗收费清单和小票用于保险报销吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Does this total include the consultation fee and medication costs?
sentences.sentence_cn: 这笔总费用包含问诊费和药费在内了吗？

sentences.sentence_en: We need the doctor's diagnosis stamped on the official claim form.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们需要在正式理赔申请表上加盖主诊医生的诊断印章。

sentences.sentence_en: Wishing you a very speedy and complete recovery, take care!
sentences.sentence_cn: 祝您早日完全康复，多加保重！

sentences.sentence_en: Hello, I am calling about the two-bedroom apartment on Pine Street.
sentences.sentence_cn: 你好，我打电话咨询一下松树街的那套两居室公寓。

sentences.sentence_en: Is this fully-furnished rental unit still available for rent?
sentences.sentence_cn: 这套家具家电齐全的整租房源目前还可以租吗？

sentences.sentence_en: What is the monthly rent and does it include any utilities?
sentences.sentence_cn: 月租金是多少钱，里面包含任何水电暖物业费吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Can we schedule an in-person viewing sometime this weekend?
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们能安排在周末什么时候实地去现场看房吗？

sentences.sentence_en: The spacious living room gets plenty of natural sunlight.
sentences.sentence_cn: 这间宽敞的客厅采光非常充沛。

sentences.sentence_en: Are the kitchen appliances like the dishwasher in good working order?
sentences.sentence_cn: 厨房里的洗碗机等家电运转都正常顺畅吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Is there an in-unit washer and dryer or a shared laundry room?
sentences.sentence_cn: 套内有自带的洗衣机烘干机，还是楼内公用洗衣房？

sentences.sentence_en: The neighborhood seems very peaceful and safe for evening walks.
sentences.sentence_cn: 这个社区周边看起来非常安静祥和，适合傍晚散步。

sentences.sentence_en: Does this residential building allow cats or small dogs?
sentences.sentence_cn: 这栋居民公寓楼允许租客饲养猫咪或小型犬吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Is there an additional pet deposit or a monthly pet fee?
sentences.sentence_cn: 需要支付额外的宠物押金或每月的宠物租金吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Does the rental contract come with an assigned underground parking spot?
sentences.sentence_cn: 租赁合同中包含一个专属的地下固定车位吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Smoking is strictly prohibited throughout the entire building.
sentences.sentence_cn: 整栋大楼内部是全天候严格禁止吸烟的。

sentences.sentence_en: Please fill out this tenancy application form with your employer details.
sentences.sentence_cn: 请填写这份租房申请表，并注明您的雇主工作信息。

sentences.sentence_en: We require two recent pay stubs and a landlord reference letter.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们需要您提供最近两期的工资单以及前房东的推荐信。

sentences.sentence_en: A standard background and credit score check will be conducted.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们将按照行业标准对您进行背景与个人信用积分审查。

sentences.sentence_en: Your application has been approved, we can proceed to sign the lease.
sentences.sentence_cn: 您的租房申请已经顺利通过审核，我们可以签约了。

sentences.sentence_en: The lease term is for twelve months starting on October first.
sentences.sentence_cn: 租约期限为十二个月，自十月一日起正式生效。

sentences.sentence_en: A security deposit equal to one month's rent is required today.
sentences.sentence_cn: 今天需要交纳相当于一个月租金额度的房屋安全押金。

sentences.sentence_en: Rent is due on the first business day of every calendar month.
sentences.sentence_cn: 房租需在每个公历月的第一个工作日之前按期支付。

sentences.sentence_en: The deposit will be refunded in full if the apartment is kept intact.
sentences.sentence_cn: 如果退租时房屋保持完好无损，押金将全额原路退还。

sentences.sentence_en: Let's complete the move-in inspection checklist together.
sentences.sentence_cn: 让我们一起逐项完成入住前验房清点检查单。

sentences.sentence_en: I noticed a small scratch on the floor, let's take a photo of it.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我发现地板上有一处小划痕，我们拍张照片记录下来吧。

sentences.sentence_en: Here are two sets of apartment keys, the mailbox key and the fob.
sentences.sentence_cn: 这是两套公寓大门钥匙、信箱钥匙和电子门禁感应卡。

sentences.sentence_en: Where do we reserve the elevator for our moving day van?
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们搬家货车到达那天，该去哪里预约货梯专运？

sentences.sentence_en: You need to call the power company to transfer the account into your name.
sentences.sentence_cn: 您需要致电电力公司，把电表账户过户到您的个人名下。

sentences.sentence_en: The technician will come tomorrow afternoon to install the fiber router.
sentences.sentence_cn: 技术安装人员明天下午会来上门安装光纤调制解调器。

sentences.sentence_en: How do we pay our monthly water and waste disposal bills?
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们每月的水费和垃圾清运费该如何缴纳？

sentences.sentence_en: You can easily set up automatic payments on their online portal.
sentences.sentence_cn: 您可以轻松在他们的官方网站上设置每月自动代扣代缴。

sentences.sentence_en: The kitchen sink pipe is leaking water all over the cabinet.
sentences.sentence_cn: 厨房水槽下方的水管正在漏水，把整个橱柜都弄湿了。

sentences.sentence_en: The heating radiator isn't turning on, the room is freezing cold.
sentences.sentence_cn: 暖气片无法开启制热，房间里冷得像冰窖一样。

sentences.sentence_en: Could you send a certified plumber over to take a look today?
sentences.sentence_cn: 今天能派一位持证水暖工师傅过来看一下吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Emergency repair service is available twenty-four hours a day.
sentences.sentence_cn: 紧急抢修售后服务每周七天二十四小时均有人值守。

sentences.sentence_en: Quiet hours in this community are from ten p.m. to eight a.m.
sentences.sentence_cn: 本社区的夜间静音休息时间是晚上十点到早上八点。

sentences.sentence_en: Our upstairs neighbor is playing loud bass music late at night.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们楼上的邻居深夜还在大声外放强低音音乐。

sentences.sentence_en: I had a polite word with them, and they promised to keep it down.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我和他们礼貌地沟通了一下，他们答应把声音调小。

sentences.sentence_en: Let's say hello and introduce ourselves to the next-door neighbors.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们去向隔壁的邻居打个招呼，做个简单的自我介绍吧。

sentences.sentence_en: I am writing to give formal thirty days' written notice to vacate.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我特此致函，正式递交提前三十天退租的书面通知。

sentences.sentence_en: We have hired professional cleaners to deep clean the entire apartment.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们已经雇佣了专业家政清洁团队对整套公寓进行了深度保洁。

sentences.sentence_en: The final walkthrough inspection went smoothly without any damage.
sentences.sentence_cn: 最终的退租验房交接非常顺利，没有发现任何设施损坏。

sentences.sentence_en: Your full security deposit will be wired to your account in five days.
sentences.sentence_cn: 您的全额房屋安全押金将在五个工作日内电汇回您的银行账户。

sentences.sentence_en: Mind if I join you? This party is really buzzing tonight!
sentences.sentence_cn: 介意我坐过来加入你们吗？今晚这场聚会真是热闹非凡！

sentences.sentence_en: How do you happen to know the host, Alex?
sentences.sentence_cn: 你是怎么和今晚的东道主亚历克斯认识的呀？

sentences.sentence_en: I love your vintage jacket, where did you find such a gem?
sentences.sentence_cn: 我太喜欢你这件复古外套了，你在哪儿淘到这件宝藏的？

sentences.sentence_en: I don't think we have been formally introduced yet, I am Daniel.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我想我们俩好像还没正式做过自我介绍，我叫丹尼尔。

sentences.sentence_en: So, what kind of work keeps you busy these days?
sentences.sentence_cn: 那你最近都在忙些什么样的工作事业呢？

sentences.sentence_en: I work as a digital product designer in a tech startup.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我在一家科技初创公司担任数字化产品设计师。

sentences.sentence_en: That sounds intellectually challenging yet fascinating!
sentences.sentence_cn: 听起来既充满智慧挑战，又非常引人入胜呢！

sentences.sentence_en: What inspired you to get into that creative field originally?
sentences.sentence_cn: 最初是什么启发激励你投身于那个创意领域的呢？

sentences.sentence_en: What do you enjoy doing during your downtime on weekends?
sentences.sentence_cn: 你周末闲暇时光通常最喜欢做些什么来放松？

sentences.sentence_en: I am a huge fan of trail running and landscape photography.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我超级热爱越野山地跑和自然风光摄影。

sentences.sentence_en: Have you ever tried rock climbing or scuba diving?
sentences.sentence_cn: 你有尝试体验过室内攀岩或是深海潜水吗？

sentences.sentence_en: We should organize a group hiking trip together next month!
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们下个月应该一起组织一次集体登山徒步活动！

sentences.sentence_en: Have you watched the latest sci-fi movie that everyone is buzzing about?
sentences.sentence_cn: 你看了最近大家都在热烈讨论的那部科幻大片了吗？

sentences.sentence_en: The plot twist at the end completely caught me off guard.
sentences.sentence_cn: 故事结局的那次大反转完全出乎了我的意料。

sentences.sentence_en: What genre of music do you find yourself listening to most?
sentences.sentence_cn: 你平时发现自己最常循环听哪种流派风格的音乐？

sentences.sentence_en: I can send you my favorite weekend chill playlist on Spotify.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我可以把你平时周末最爱听的放松歌单在声网分享给你。

sentences.sentence_en: You gave an incredibly insightful presentation earlier today.
sentences.sentence_cn: 你今天早些时候的那场演讲分享真是极具真知灼见。

sentences.sentence_en: Thank you so much, that really means a lot coming from you.
sentences.sentence_cn: 非常感谢，从你口中听到这番夸奖对我而言意义重大。

sentences.sentence_en: Your culinary skills are out of this world, this pie is heavenly!
sentences.sentence_cn: 你的烹饪厨艺简直绝了，这个派美味得犹如天上之物！

sentences.sentence_en: I am thrilled you enjoyed it, I used my grandmother's secret recipe.
sentences.sentence_cn: 太高兴你喜欢吃它了，我用的是我祖母传下来的独门秘方。

sentences.sentence_en: That is fascinating, tell me more about how that turned out!
sentences.sentence_cn: 那太不可思议了，快多跟我讲讲那件事后来怎么样了！

sentences.sentence_en: I can totally relate to what you just described.
sentences.sentence_cn: 对于你刚才所描述的那种感受，我完全感同身受。

sentences.sentence_en: So, what did you decide to do when that happened?
sentences.sentence_cn: 那么当那种情况突然发生时，你最后决定怎么做的呢？

sentences.sentence_en: Speaking of which, that reminds me of a crazy story from last summer.
sentences.sentence_cn: 说到这里，这让我想起了去年夏天发生的一件离奇趣事。

sentences.sentence_en: A few of us are planning a backyard barbecue this Saturday afternoon.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们几个人正打算本周六下午在后院搞一次烧烤聚会。

sentences.sentence_en: Would you be interested in joining us for some delicious food and drinks?
sentences.sentence_cn: 你有兴趣加入我们一起吃点好吃的喝两杯吗？

sentences.sentence_en: I would absolutely love that, what can I bring along to contribute?
sentences.sentence_cn: 我太乐意去了，我能带点什么吃的或喝的去贡献一份力量？

sentences.sentence_en: Just bring your wonderful self and good spirits, we have everything covered.
sentences.sentence_cn: 只要把开心的你自己带过来就好啦，其他东西我们全包办了。

sentences.sentence_en: I would really love to come, but I already have prior family plans.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我真的非常想去，但我之前已经和家人有约在先了。

sentences.sentence_en: Thank you so much for thinking of me, I truly appreciate the invite.
sentences.sentence_cn: 非常感谢你能想着邀请我，我真心感激你的好意。

sentences.sentence_en: Can I take a rain check and join you folks next time around?
sentences.sentence_cn: 这次能先给我发张‘改期券’吗，下次活动我一定到场！

sentences.sentence_en: No worries at all, we will definitely catch you at the next one!
sentences.sentence_cn: 完全没关系，我们下次活动的时候再聚！

sentences.sentence_en: Are you on Instagram or LinkedIn? Let's connect there!
sentences.sentence_cn: 你有玩照片墙或者领英吗？我们上面互粉好友吧！

sentences.sentence_en: Let me scan your QR code so I have your contact details.
sentences.sentence_cn: 让我扫一下你的二维码，这样我就有你的联系方式了。

sentences.sentence_en: I will text you the address and event link later this evening.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我今晚晚些时候会把具体地址和活动链接发短信给你。

sentences.sentence_en: It was genuinely delightful meeting you today, stay in touch!
sentences.sentence_cn: 今天能认识你真是令人心情大好，记得保持联系哦！

sentences.sentence_en: Look at the clock, I really must get going before it gets too late.
sentences.sentence_cn: 看一眼时间，在太晚之前我真的得准备动身回去啦。

sentences.sentence_en: Thank you for being such an extraordinary and gracious host!
sentences.sentence_cn: 非常感谢你今晚作为东道主如此体贴非凡的热情招待！

sentences.sentence_en: I had an absolute blast tonight, thank you everyone for the laughs.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我今晚玩得尽兴极了，感谢大家带给我的欢声笑语。

sentences.sentence_en: Get home safely everyone, let's do this again very soon!
sentences.sentence_cn: 大家回去路上都注意安全，咱们不久之后一定要再聚！

sentences.sentence_en: A big black cat sat on the fat mat.
sentences.sentence_cn: 一只黑色的大肥猫端坐在肥厚的垫子上。

sentences.sentence_en: He wants to eat sweet green beans by the sea.
sentences.sentence_cn: 他想在大海边吃甜甜的青豆角。

sentences.sentence_en: Ship or sheep, listen carefully to the vowel length.
sentences.sentence_cn: 是船还是绵羊，仔细倾听元音的长短差异。

sentences.sentence_en: Keep your mouth relaxed when pronouncing the short vowel.
sentences.sentence_cn: 发短元音的时候让你的嘴部肌肉保持放松。

sentences.sentence_en: Fresh green grass grows across the broad valley.
sentences.sentence_cn: 新鲜的绿草漫山遍野地生长在开阔的山谷里。

sentences.sentence_en: The smart street cleaner stopped at the traffic light.
sentences.sentence_cn: 精明的环卫工人在红绿灯前停下了脚步。

sentences.sentence_en: Please split the clear glass into three neat parts.
sentences.sentence_cn: 请把这块透明的玻璃分割成整齐的三份。

sentences.sentence_en: Practice blowing air through your lips with strong energy.
sentences.sentence_cn: 练习用饱满的气流从两唇之间爆发吹出。

sentences.sentence_en: Hop becomes hope, and cap turns into cape with an E.
sentences.sentence_cn: 有了字母E，hop变成hope，cap变成cape。

sentences.sentence_en: I write with my right hand in bright daylight.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我在明亮的日光下用我的右手提笔写字。

sentences.sentence_en: Do you know who knocked on the heavy wooden door?
sentences.sentence_cn: 你知道是谁敲响了那扇沉重的厚木门吗？

sentences.sentence_en: The silent K and W should never be voiced aloud.
sentences.sentence_cn: 那些不发音的字母K和W千万不要大声读出来。

sentences.sentence_en: She sells shiny seashells on the sunny seashore.
sentences.sentence_cn: 她在阳光明媚的海岸边叫卖闪亮的贝壳。

sentences.sentence_en: Put your tongue between your teeth to make the TH sound.
sentences.sentence_cn: 把你的舌尖轻轻放在上下牙齿之间来发出TH咬舌音。

sentences.sentence_en: Think of three thoughtful brothers walking together.
sentences.sentence_cn: 想一想三位体贴体谅的亲兄弟一起并肩走来。

sentences.sentence_en: Which white whale went swimming westward in the sea?
sentences.sentence_cn: 是哪只白鲸在蔚蓝的大海里向着西方游去？

sentences.sentence_en: Pass me a fresh bottle of cold drinking water, please.
sentences.sentence_cn: 请递给我一瓶新鲜冰凉的饮用水。

sentences.sentence_en: The American pronunciation sounds like a quick light D.
sentences.sentence_cn: 美式闪音T听起来就像一个快速轻巧的D音。

sentences.sentence_en: Betty bought a little bit of better yellow butter.
sentences.sentence_cn: 贝蒂买了一点点品质更好的优质黄油。

sentences.sentence_en: In words like mountain, the T sound is held in the throat.
sentences.sentence_cn: 在像mountain这样的单词中，T音会被喉部短暂闭气卡住。

sentences.sentence_en: Hold on a second and think about it for a minute.
sentences.sentence_cn: 等一下，花上一分钟时间好好考虑考虑它。

sentences.sentence_en: Pick it up and check if everything is in place.
sentences.sentence_cn: 把它捡起来，检查一下是否每样东西都就位了。

sentences.sentence_en: Connect the ending consonant smoothly into the next vowel.
sentences.sentence_cn: 把前一个词尾的辅音丝滑自然地连入下一个词首的元音中。

sentences.sentence_en: Turn off the lights and come over here right now.
sentences.sentence_cn: 把灯关掉，现在就马上走过来这里。

sentences.sentence_en: A cup of tea and a piece of chocolate cake.
sentences.sentence_cn: 一杯红茶配一块香浓的巧克力蛋糕。

sentences.sentence_en: The schwa is the most frequent unstressed sound in English.
sentences.sentence_cn: 中央元音弱读是英语中出现频次最高的不重读发音。

sentences.sentence_en: Banana, Canada, and tomorrow all have reduced vowels.
sentences.sentence_cn: 香蕉、加拿大和明天这些单词中都含有弱读元音。

sentences.sentence_en: Relax your tongue in the center without pushing forward.
sentences.sentence_cn: 把你的舌头放松在口腔正中央，不要用力往前推。

sentences.sentence_en: The early bird catches the juicy green worm in spring.
sentences.sentence_cn: 早起的鸟儿在春天能捉到多汁的青绿小虫。

sentences.sentence_en: Park your sports car near the corner of the supermarket.
sentences.sentence_cn: 把你的小跑车停在超级市场拐角附近的地方吧。

sentences.sentence_en: Curl the tip of your tongue slightly backwards with warmth.
sentences.sentence_cn: 将你的舌尖带着温度向后方微微自然卷起。

sentences.sentence_en: Four smart doctors worked hard together in the hospital.
sentences.sentence_cn: 四位聪颖的大夫在医院里并肩辛勤工作。

sentences.sentence_en: Stress the content words and rush through the grammar words.
sentences.sentence_cn: 重读表达实意的实词，快速带过纯语法的虚词。

sentences.sentence_en: English is a stress-timed language with a steady beat.
sentences.sentence_cn: 英语是一种以重音定节拍、节奏感鲜明的语言。

sentences.sentence_en: I never said she stole the money from my wallet.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我从来没有说过是她从我钱包里偷走了这笔钱。

sentences.sentence_en: Changing which word you stress completely shifts the meaning.
sentences.sentence_cn: 改变你在句中所强调的词汇，会彻底转变整个句意。

sentences.sentence_en: Falling intonation signals certainty and a completed thought.
sentences.sentence_cn: 句尾降调通常象征着笃定确信与完整表达的陈述。

sentences.sentence_en: Rising intonation asks for confirmation or shows genuine curiosity.
sentences.sentence_cn: 句尾升调常用于寻求他人确认或表达由衷的好奇心。

sentences.sentence_en: Really? Are you sure you saw him at the conference?
sentences.sentence_cn: 真的吗？你敢确定你今天在大会现场亲眼见到他了？

sentences.sentence_en: Speak with natural rhythm, confidence and vibrant vocal energy!
sentences.sentence_cn: 带着自然的节奏、自信的魄力与鲜活的声音能量开口说话！

sentences.sentence_en: Set the microwave timer for two minutes on high power.
sentences.sentence_cn: 把微波炉定时器调到高火加热两分钟。

sentences.sentence_en: Preheat the electric oven to three hundred and fifty degrees.
sentences.sentence_cn: 将电烤箱提前预热到华氏三百五十度。

sentences.sentence_en: Don't forget to clean the coffee machine filter after brewing.
sentences.sentence_cn: 煮完咖啡后别忘了把咖啡机的滤网清洗干净。

sentences.sentence_en: This induction cooktop heats up water in just seconds.
sentences.sentence_cn: 这台电磁炉烧开一壶水仅仅只需要几十秒钟。

sentences.sentence_en: Separate the white garments from the dark colored clothes.
sentences.sentence_cn: 把浅白色的衣物和深色有颜色的衣服分开洗涤。

sentences.sentence_en: Add two caps of liquid detergent and fabric softener.
sentences.sentence_cn: 倒入两瓶盖的洗衣液和柔顺护理剂。

sentences.sentence_en: Choose the delicate cycle for wool and silk fabrics.
sentences.sentence_cn: 针对羊毛和真丝面料请选用轻柔洗涤档位。

sentences.sentence_en: Hang the damp shirts outside on the balcony to air dry.
sentences.sentence_cn: 把湿润的衬衫拿到阳台外面晾晒风干。

sentences.sentence_en: I will vacuum the living room carpet and mop the tile floor.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我来用吸尘器吸客厅地毯，然后拖洗瓷砖地面。

sentences.sentence_en: Wipe down the dusty kitchen countertops with disinfectant spray.
sentences.sentence_cn: 用消毒喷雾把积灰的厨房料理台面仔细擦拭干净。

sentences.sentence_en: The robot vacuum cleaner navigates automatically around furniture.
sentences.sentence_cn: 这台扫地机器人会自动在各类家具周围智能避障穿梭。

sentences.sentence_en: Everything looks sparkling clean and smells so fresh!
sentences.sentence_cn: 每一处都看起来光洁如新，闻起来清新怡人！

sentences.sentence_en: The kitchen trash can is full, time to replace the plastic liner.
sentences.sentence_cn: 厨房垃圾桶已经装满了，该换一个新的塑料垃圾袋了。

sentences.sentence_en: Plastic bottles and clean cardboard boxes go into the blue bin.
sentences.sentence_cn: 塑料水瓶和干净的纸板箱应当投入蓝色可回收箱。

sentences.sentence_en: Food scraps and kitchen waste belong in the compost container.
sentences.sentence_cn: 食物残渣和厨余果皮属于绿色有机堆肥容器。

sentences.sentence_en: Garbage collection day in our street is every Tuesday morning.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们街道每逢周二清晨会由市政垃圾车上门集中回收。

sentences.sentence_en: Give the indoor potted green plants a thorough watering today.
sentences.sentence_cn: 今天把室内摆放的绿植盆栽都彻底浇一遍透水吧。

sentences.sentence_en: This succulent plant loves abundant sunlight and dry soil.
sentences.sentence_cn: 这株多肉植物非常喜爱充沛的阳光和偏干燥的土壤。

sentences.sentence_en: Trim off the yellow dried leaves with sharp garden shears.
sentences.sentence_cn: 用锋利的园艺剪把那些发黄干枯的老叶子修剪掉。

sentences.sentence_en: The pink rose buds on the balcony are starting to bloom.
sentences.sentence_cn: 阳台上的粉色玫瑰花苞正在含苞初放、徐徐盛开。

sentences.sentence_en: Fill up the dog's bowl with crunchy kibble and fresh water.
sentences.sentence_cn: 把狗狗的饭碗盛满香脆的狗粮并倒满新鲜的清水。

sentences.sentence_en: Grab the leash, let's take golden retriever for a stroll.
sentences.sentence_cn: 把牵引绳拿上，咱们带金毛犬去小区里溜达一圈。

sentences.sentence_en: Remember to scoop and replenish the cat litter box daily.
sentences.sentence_cn: 记得每天都要铲猫砂并及时补充新的无尘膨润土。

sentences.sentence_en: The playful little kitten loves chasing laser pointer beams.
sentences.sentence_cn: 这只顽皮活泼的小猫咪最爱追逐激光笔投射的光点了。

sentences.sentence_en: Hand me the Phillips screwdriver to tighten this loose screw.
sentences.sentence_cn: 把那把十字螺丝刀递给我，我来把这颗松动的螺丝拧紧。

sentences.sentence_en: The ceiling light bulb burned out, we need a replacement LED.
sentences.sentence_cn: 天花板上的吸顶灯泡烧坏了，我们需要换个新LED灯珠。

sentences.sentence_en: Turn off the main electrical circuit breaker before touching wires.
sentences.sentence_cn: 在触碰任何电线前，务必先关掉家里的总电路断路器开关。

sentences.sentence_en: A roll of heavy-duty duct tape can temporarily fix almost anything.
sentences.sentence_cn: 一卷高强度的强力胶带几乎能临时修补固定任何东西。

sentences.sentence_en: It's time to pack away thick winter down jackets into vacuum bags.
sentences.sentence_cn: 是时候把厚重的冬季羽绒服放进抽真空压缩袋里收纳了。

sentences.sentence_en: Donate the clothes you haven't worn in over two full years.
sentences.sentence_cn: 把那些你已经超过整整两年没再穿过的旧衣服捐赠出去吧。

sentences.sentence_en: Label each transparent storage bin so things are easy to find.
sentences.sentence_cn: 在每个透明塑料收纳箱上贴好标签，找东西就会很方便。

sentences.sentence_en: Hanging clothes by color makes the wardrobe look stunning.
sentences.sentence_cn: 按照颜色分类悬挂衣物能让整个衣柜看起来美观赏心悦目。

sentences.sentence_en: Test the battery in the ceiling smoke detector twice a year.
sentences.sentence_cn: 天花板上的烟雾报警器电池建议每年至少测试检查两次。

sentences.sentence_en: Always double-check that the front deadbolt lock is engaged.
sentences.sentence_cn: 出门前务必二次确认正门的防盗插销锁已经锁闭到位。

sentences.sentence_en: The smart video doorbell notifies my phone when visitors ring.
sentences.sentence_cn: 当有访客按门铃时，智能可视门铃会第一时间推送至手机。

sentences.sentence_en: Keep the home first-aid kit stocked with band-aids and ointment.
sentences.sentence_cn: 让家里的急救医疗箱始终常备创口贴和消毒药膏。

sentences.sentence_en: Sunday family dinner is our cherished weekly tradition.
sentences.sentence_cn: 周日全家温馨聚餐是我们全家最为珍视的每周传统仪式。

sentences.sentence_en: We turn off our smartphones and enjoy meaningful conversations.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们把各自的智能手机静音收起，享受有深度的面对面交流。

sentences.sentence_en: Cooking a delicious roast chicken together fills home with warmth.
sentences.sentence_cn: 一起合作烤出一只香气四溢的烤鸡，让整座屋子满溢温暖。

sentences.sentence_en: There is truly no place as warm and comforting as home.
sentences.sentence_cn: 世间真的没有任何地方能比得上家的温馨与踏实。

sentences.sentence_en: Thank you for reaching out to us regarding our solar products.
sentences.sentence_cn: 非常感谢您就我们的太阳能产品系列向我们发起业务询盘。

sentences.sentence_en: I have attached our latest product catalog and price list for review.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我已附上我们最新的产品宣传图册与报价清单供您审阅。

sentences.sentence_en: Could you please specify your estimated order volume and target market?
sentences.sentence_cn: 能否请您说明一下您的预估订单规模以及目标销售市场？

sentences.sentence_en: We pride ourselves on providing top-tier manufacturing quality standards.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们为能够提供行业顶尖标准的制造品质工艺而深感自豪。

sentences.sentence_en: We are pleased to provide complimentary product samples for testing.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们非常乐意为您提供免费的产品实物样品用于性能测试。

sentences.sentence_en: Could you provide your DHL or FedEx courier account for freight collection?
sentences.sentence_cn: 能否提供您的中外运敦豪或联邦快递账号以便运费到付？

sentences.sentence_en: Customized samples usually take seven business days to manufacture.
sentences.sentence_cn: 根据客户个性化定制的打样通常需要七个工作日来完成制作。

sentences.sentence_en: Here is your tracking number, the parcel was dispatched this morning.
sentences.sentence_cn: 这是您的国际快递单号，包裹已于今天清晨正式寄出。

sentences.sentence_en: Our standard minimum order quantity for this model is five hundred units.
sentences.sentence_cn: 该型号产品我们标准的最少起订量为五百台。

sentences.sentence_en: To help you test your local market, we can accept a trial order of two hundred.
sentences.sentence_cn: 为了协助您测试本地市场反响，我们破例接受两百台的试单。

sentences.sentence_en: A higher order volume allows us to optimize raw material procurement costs.
sentences.sentence_cn: 更大的订单采购量能让我们在原材料采购端获得更优的成本优化。

sentences.sentence_en: We are eager to establish a mutually rewarding long-term partnership with you.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们热切期盼能与贵公司建立起互利互惠的长远合作共赢关系。

sentences.sentence_en: Our quoted price is based on FOB Shanghai in US dollars.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们目前给出的报价是基于离岸价FOB上海港、以美元结算的。

sentences.sentence_en: Would you prefer us to quote on CIF terms including marine insurance?
sentences.sentence_cn: 您是否更倾向于让我们提供包含海运保费在内的到岸价CIF报价？

sentences.sentence_en: This special price quotation remains valid for thirty calendar days.
sentences.sentence_cn: 本期专属优惠价格报价单在三十个自然日内持续有效。

sentences.sentence_en: The recent surge in ocean shipping freight rates has impacted export costs.
sentences.sentence_cn: 近期国际海运运价的大幅上涨对整体出口成本造成了一定冲击。

sentences.sentence_en: Our standard payment term is thirty percent deposit via telegraphic transfer.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们标准的付款条款是支付百分之三十的电汇T/T预付定金。

sentences.sentence_en: The remaining seventy percent balance is payable against the bill of lading copy.
sentences.sentence_cn: 其余百分之七十的尾款见提单B/L副本后电汇结清。

sentences.sentence_en: For large volume transactions, we accept an irrevocable letter of credit at sight.
sentences.sentence_cn: 针对大宗大额贸易，我们接受开具即期不可撤销信用证结算。

sentences.sentence_en: Please notify your issuing bank to open the credit according to our proforma invoice.
sentences.sentence_cn: 请通知您的开证行严格按照我们的形式发票PI条款开出信用证。

sentences.sentence_en: We warmly welcome your technical team to visit and audit our automated plant.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们热烈欢迎贵方的技术专家团队随时前来参观并审查我们的自动化工厂。

sentences.sentence_en: Our modern manufacturing facility is fully certified under ISO9001 and CE.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们现代化的制造工厂已全面获得ISO9001质量体系认证和欧盟CE准入认证。

sentences.sentence_en: We cooperate fully with third-party inspection agencies like SGS and BV.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们全力配合通标SGS或必维BV等国际知名第三方专业质检机构。

sentences.sentence_en: Every finished unit undergoes a rigorous forty-eight hour burn-in stress test.
sentences.sentence_cn: 每一台出厂成品均需通过长达四十八小时的严苛通电老化与压力测试。

sentences.sentence_en: Mass production will commence immediately upon receipt of the deposit.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们在正式收到首笔定金电汇水单后，将第一时间开工投产批量生产。

sentences.sentence_en: The estimated manufacturing lead time will be approximately four weeks.
sentences.sentence_cn: 预估的整个生产制造交货周期大约为四个自然周。

sentences.sentence_en: I am writing to share weekly photo updates showing your order's assembly progress.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我特此致信向您同步每周照片进度，展示您订单当前的装配组装情况。

sentences.sentence_en: Everything is progressing smoothly ahead of the scheduled completion date.
sentences.sentence_cn: 目前各项工序推进顺利，甚至有望先于既定完工日期提前交付。

sentences.sentence_en: We use reinforced five-ply corrugated export cartons to protect the goods.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们统一选用五层高强度加厚瓦楞出口专用外箱以保护货物安全。

sentences.sentence_en: Each wooden pallet will be professionally heat-treated and fumigated.
sentences.sentence_cn: 每一个实木托盘在装箱前均会经过严格的专业热处理与熏蒸防虫处理。

sentences.sentence_en: Could you send us the high-resolution vector file for your brand logo printing?
sentences.sentence_cn: 能否将贵方品牌Logo的高清矢量图文件发送给我们进行丝印打样？

sentences.sentence_en: Shipping marks will be printed clearly on all four sides of each outer carton.
sentences.sentence_cn: 每件外箱的四个侧面均会按要求清晰印制规范的进出口运输唛头。

sentences.sentence_en: The commercial invoice, packing list, and bill of lading are ready.
sentences.sentence_cn: 商业发票、装箱单以及正本海运提单均已制作核对完毕。

sentences.sentence_en: We have applied for the official Certificate of Origin to lower your import tariff.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们已向贸促会申请了官方原产地证书，以帮助您在目的港降低关税。

sentences.sentence_en: Would you like us to release the cargo by telex release instead of original paper?
sentences.sentence_cn: 您是否希望我们采用电放提单Telex Release而非邮寄正本纸质提单？

sentences.sentence_en: The container has been loaded on board the vessel and departed on schedule.
sentences.sentence_cn: 整装集装箱货柜已顺利吊装上船，并已按原定船期准点启航离港。

sentences.sentence_en: We provide a comprehensive twelve-month warranty covering all core components.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们为所有核心功能零部件提供长达十二个月的无忧质量保证。

sentences.sentence_en: We will supply two percent free spare parts alongside every batch shipment.
sentences.sentence_cn: 随同每一批次的大货发运，我们均会额外随赠百分之二的免费易损备件。

sentences.sentence_en: How are sales performing on your end? Are you planning a reorder soon?
sentences.sentence_cn: 在您那边的终端市场销售势头如何？您近期有追加翻单的采购计划吗？

sentences.sentence_en: We deeply value your ongoing trust and look forward to our next big milestone.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们由衷珍视贵司长久以来的信任，热切期待携手迈向下一个崭新里程碑。

sentences.sentence_en: I hope this email finds you well and having a productive week.
sentences.sentence_cn: 见信安好，祝您本周各项工作顺利开展、卓有成效。

sentences.sentence_en: Thank you for getting back to me so promptly regarding the project.
sentences.sentence_cn: 非常感谢您在第一时间就该项目事宜给予我如此迅速及时的回复。

sentences.sentence_en: I am writing to follow up on our fruitful discussion during yesterday's call.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我特此致信，旨在就我们昨日电话会议中富有成效的探讨做进一步跟进。

sentences.sentence_en: It was a real pleasure meeting you at the annual global conference in Chicago.
sentences.sentence_cn: 非常荣幸上周能在芝加哥举行的全球年度行业峰会上与您当面结识。

sentences.sentence_en: I would like to provide a brief status update on the third-quarter initiative.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我想简要向您同步汇报一下第三季度重大战略项目的最新推进现状。

sentences.sentence_en: Our engineering team has successfully finalized phase one ahead of schedule.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们的技术研发工程团队已比原定计划提前顺利攻坚完成了第一阶段任务。

sentences.sentence_en: Please find the detailed quarterly KPI dashboard attached for your review.
sentences.sentence_cn: 随信附上详尽的季度关键业绩指标可视化数据看板，供您审阅指导。

sentences.sentence_en: We remain fully on track to achieve our financial targets by year-end.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们依然完全按照既定节奏稳步推进，有充分信心在年底达成既定财务目标。

sentences.sentence_en: Could you please review the attached proposal and share your thoughts?
sentences.sentence_cn: 能否请您抽空审阅随附的项目提案，并不吝赐教分享您的宝贵见解？

sentences.sentence_en: Kindly provide your feedback by end of business this coming Thursday.
sentences.sentence_cn: 如蒙惠允，烦请于本周四下班前将您的修改反馈意见惠赐给我。

sentences.sentence_en: Please let me know if you approve this draft so we can proceed to sign.
sentences.sentence_cn: 若您原则上批准此份草案，请知会我一声，以便我们推进后续签约流转。

sentences.sentence_en: Your timely sign-off on this budget request is essential for execution.
sentences.sentence_cn: 您对此项预算拨款申请的及时签署批准，对于项目后续执行推进至关重要。

sentences.sentence_en: Just a gentle follow-up regarding the contract sent earlier this week.
sentences.sentence_cn: 在此仅就本周早些时候发给您的合同文本做一个温和的跟进提醒。

sentences.sentence_en: I understand you have a packed schedule, but I wanted to bump this email.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我深知您近期日理万机公务繁忙，但还是想把这封关键邮件往前提一下。

sentences.sentence_en: Could you please confirm if you have had an opportunity to review the file?
sentences.sentence_cn: 能否请您帮忙确认一下，您近日是否已有机会对该文件进行过审阅？

sentences.sentence_en: We would greatly appreciate an update at your earliest convenience.
sentences.sentence_cn: 若能在您方便的最初时刻收到您的最新进展回复，我们将不胜感激。

sentences.sentence_en: Due to unexpected supply chain bottlenecks, delivery will be slightly delayed.
sentences.sentence_cn: 由于突发的供应链物流堵点瓶颈，本次交付时间将出现轻微延期。

sentences.sentence_en: We are actively taking mitigation measures to minimize any potential impact.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们目前正在积极采取各项补救缓解举措，全力将任何潜在影响降到最低。

sentences.sentence_en: The revised estimated completion date is now set for next Wednesday.
sentences.sentence_cn: 经重新评估后调整的最新完工节点现已明确顺延至下周三前完成。

sentences.sentence_en: We deeply apologize for any inconvenience this temporary delay may cause.
sentences.sentence_cn: 对于此项阶段性延期可能给贵司带来的任何不便，我们致以由衷的歉意。

sentences.sentence_en: While I understand your rationale, I have some reservations about this timeline.
sentences.sentence_cn: 虽然我非常理解您的立论依据，但我对当前这一推进时间表仍存有一丝保留。

sentences.sentence_en: May I propose an alternative approach that might reduce compliance risks?
sentences.sentence_cn: 我能否冒昧提出另一套备选方案，或许能更有力地降低合规与风控风险？

sentences.sentence_en: From a cost efficiency standpoint, option B appears to offer stronger returns.
sentences.sentence_cn: 纯粹从成本效益投资回报的维度考量，选项B所展现的收益潜力明显更胜一筹。

sentences.sentence_en: I would welcome the opportunity to discuss these trade-offs briefly over a call.
sentences.sentence_cn: 如果方便的话，我非常期待能与您通过电话简要梳理并权衡这些利弊得失。

sentences.sentence_en: To ensure we are completely aligned, let me summarize the main takeaways.
sentences.sentence_cn: 为确保我们双方在认知上完全对齐无误，请允许我简要梳理一下核心要点。

sentences.sentence_en: Could you please clarify what you meant by scalable infrastructure architecture?
sentences.sentence_cn: 能否请您进一步阐明一下，您所提及的高可扩展性底层架构具体指代何物？

sentences.sentence_en: Just to confirm, are we waiting on legal approval before releasing payment?
sentences.sentence_cn: 向您再核实一下，我们是否必须等到法务合规部门最终审批通过后才放款？

sentences.sentence_en: Please let me know if my interpretation accurately reflects your expectations.
sentences.sentence_cn: 若我的理解与阐述能够准确契合反映您的初始预期，请不吝告知于我。

sentences.sentence_en: I would like to extend my heartfelt gratitude for your relentless dedication.
sentences.sentence_cn: 对于您在此次攻坚战中所倾注的不懈心血与卓越奉献，我想表达由衷的感激。

sentences.sentence_en: Your exceptional leadership made all the difference in clinching this deal.
sentences.sentence_cn: 正是凭借您出类拔萃的战略领导力，才让我们最终一举敲定锁定了这一大单。

sentences.sentence_en: A big shout-out to the operations team for pulling off this remarkable feat.
sentences.sentence_cn: 向我们默默付出的运营实施团队致以崇高的敬意，感谢他们创造的非凡业绩！

sentences.sentence_en: It has been an absolute privilege collaborating closely alongside your group.
sentences.sentence_cn: 能与您所带领的优秀团队开展如此紧密无间的深度合作，实乃我莫大的荣幸。

sentences.sentence_en: Thank you for your message. I am currently out of the office until Monday.
sentences.sentence_cn: 感谢您的来信。我目前因公外出休假，将于下周一正式返岗回司履职。

sentences.sentence_en: I will have limited access to email and will respond promptly upon my return.
sentences.sentence_cn: 外出期间我查阅邮件的频次受限，待我返岗后会第一时间尽快给您做出回复。

sentences.sentence_en: For urgent inquiries that cannot wait, please contact Sarah at the email below.
sentences.sentence_cn: 若遇刻不容缓的万分紧急事宜，请随时联系代理负责人莎拉，邮箱详见下方。

sentences.sentence_en: Thank you for your patience and understanding during my brief absence.
sentences.sentence_cn: 非常感谢您在我短暂离岗期间所给予的极大耐心、包容与充分谅解。

sentences.sentence_en: Please feel free to reach out if you have any questions or require clarification.
sentences.sentence_cn: 若您存有任何疑虑或需要进一步澄清说明，请随时与我取得联系。

sentences.sentence_en: I look forward to hearing your insights and continuing our conversation.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我翘首以待能聆听您的真知灼见，并持续深化推进我们富有成果的对话。

sentences.sentence_en: Wishing you continued success in all your forthcoming business endeavors.
sentences.sentence_cn: 衷心祝愿贵司在未来的各项宏伟商业版图与征程中不断斩获辉煌成功。

sentences.sentence_en: Warm regards and best wishes, Daniel Evans, Managing Director.
sentences.sentence_cn: 顺颂商祺，致以最诚挚的问候，执行董事丹尼尔·埃文斯顿首。

sentences.sentence_en: Can everyone hear me clearly and see my shared screen okay?
sentences.sentence_cn: 各位目前能清晰听见我的声音，并且正常看清我共享的屏幕画面吗？

sentences.sentence_en: You are on mute, Alex, could you please unmute your microphone?
sentences.sentence_cn: 亚历克斯，您的麦克风目前处于静音状态，能否麻烦您取消一下静音？

sentences.sentence_en: There seems to be an echo on the line, please mute if you are not speaking.
sentences.sentence_cn: 线路上似乎产生了一点回音干扰，请暂时未发言的同仁随手开启静音。

sentences.sentence_en: Let's give everyone another minute to join before we kick off.
sentences.sentence_cn: 在正式切入主题前，我们不妨再多给其他尚未上线的同事一分钟接入。

sentences.sentence_en: Good morning everyone, thank you all for dialing in on such short notice.
sentences.sentence_cn: 大家早上好，非常感谢各位在如此紧急临时的通知下准时拨入视频会议。

sentences.sentence_en: The main objective of today's sync is to finalize the product launch strategy.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们今日召开同步会的核心主旨，是最终敲定产品上线发布战略方案。

sentences.sentence_en: We have four key topics on the agenda and an hour on the clock.
sentences.sentence_cn: 今天我们在议程表上共列有四大议题，会议总时长严格控制在一小时以内。

sentences.sentence_en: Let's dive straight into item number one without further ado.
sentences.sentence_cn: 闲言少叙，言归正传，我们现在直接切入研讨第一个核心议题。

sentences.sentence_en: Allow me to share my deck and walk you through the key findings.
sentences.sentence_cn: 请允许我共享我的演示文稿PPT，并带各位逐一浏览梳理关键核心洞察。

sentences.sentence_en: As you can see from this monthly bar chart, user retention increased sharply.
sentences.sentence_cn: 正如各位从这幅月度柱状图中所清晰见到的，用户留存率呈现显著猛增。

sentences.sentence_en: I would like to draw your attention to the breakdown in the lower right.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我想特别提请各位重点关注位于图表右下角的这项明细数据剖析。

sentences.sentence_en: Let me zoom in slightly so the financial figures are easier to read.
sentences.sentence_cn: 让我把页面稍稍放大一些，以便大家能更清晰地看清各项财务收支数据。

sentences.sentence_en: From my perspective, focusing on user experience will unlock long-term loyalty.
sentences.sentence_cn: 依我愚见，坚定不移地聚焦于用户体验才是撬动用户长期忠诚度的命脉所在。

sentences.sentence_en: I believe we need to allocate more marketing resources to social media channels.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我认为我们有必要在社交新媒体营销获客渠道上倾斜调配更多的预算资源。

sentences.sentence_en: That is an intriguing angle, but have we factored in potential compliance risks?
sentences.sentence_cn: 那确实是一个令人耳目一新的切入视角，但不知我们是否已把合规风险测算在内？

sentences.sentence_en: I would like to build on what Rachel just highlighted regarding retention.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我想沿着刚才瑞秋就用户留存这一维度所精辟指出的要点做进一步延展补充。

sentences.sentence_en: Sorry to interrupt, but could you clarify that last statistic you cited?
sentences.sentence_cn: 非常抱歉打断一下，但能否请您就刚才援引的那项最新统计数据再澄清一下？

sentences.sentence_en: I raised my virtual hand, may I jump in with a quick question?
sentences.sentence_cn: 我刚才在界面上点了举手功能，我能否插进来请教一个简短的关键问题？

sentences.sentence_en: Before we move on to the next slide, I have a quick comment to make.
sentences.sentence_cn: 在我们翻到下一张幻灯片前，我个人这里有一点简短的建议想顺带提一下。

sentences.sentence_en: Go ahead, David, the floor is all yours, please share your thoughts.
sentences.sentence_cn: 请讲吧，大卫，话筒交给你了，请畅所欲言分享您的思考。

sentences.sentence_en: I see where you are coming from, however our customer feedback suggests otherwise.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我完全理解您的立场出发点，然而我们一手收集的客户原声反馈却并非如此。

sentences.sentence_en: We appear to have differing viewpoints on this pricing model.
sentences.sentence_cn: 在这一定价商业模型的选择上，我们双方目前似乎存在着截然不同的视点。

sentences.sentence_en: Let's avoid getting bogged down in minutiae and stay focused on big picture.
sentences.sentence_cn: 让我们先不要过度深陷于枝节微瑕的泥潭中，始终紧扣宏观大局战略方向。

sentences.sentence_en: Can we find common ground where both marketing and finance feel comfortable?
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们能否探寻出一片中间地带的共同公约数，让市场部与财务部都能欣然接受？

sentences.sentence_en: We are conscious of time, so let's keep remaining remarks concise.
sentences.sentence_cn: 考虑到会议时间已所剩无几，接下来的诸位发言同仁请尽可能言简意赅。

sentences.sentence_en: That is an important topic, but let's park it for a dedicated offline deep-dive.
sentences.sentence_cn: 那确是一个重大课题，但我们不妨先将其搁置，会后另辟专题闭门深研。

sentences.sentence_en: We have five minutes remaining, so let's transition toward next action steps.
sentences.sentence_cn: 距离会议预定结束还剩最后五分钟，我们现在正式转向落实后续行动纲领。

sentences.sentence_en: I want to respect everyone's hard stop at eleven o'clock sharp.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我充分尊重并恪守大家在十一点整准时散会奔赴下一场安排的硬性时间限制。

sentences.sentence_en: Let's clearly identify the designated owner for each critical task.
sentences.sentence_cn: 让我们明确责任到人，为每一项至关紧要的核心攻坚任务指定具体责任主管。

sentences.sentence_en: Mark will take ownership of updating the architectural blueprint by Friday.
sentences.sentence_cn: 马克将全权牵头负责，在周五之前拿出更新完毕的系统架构工程蓝图。

sentences.sentence_en: Sarah, can you coordinate with the external vendor on timeline feasibility?
sentences.sentence_cn: 莎拉，你能否代表公司直接与外部供应商就时间节点的可行性进行密切协同？

sentences.sentence_en: All deliverables must be submitted to the shared repository before sign-off.
sentences.sentence_cn: 所有的阶段性交付成果在最终验收前，均必须规范上传归档至团队共享资料库。

sentences.sentence_en: To recap, we have officially reached consensus on the revised product roadmap.
sentences.sentence_cn: 简明扼要回顾一下，我们今日已正式就修订版的产品演进路线图达成了高度共识。

sentences.sentence_en: I will circulate comprehensive meeting minutes along with the recording link.
sentences.sentence_cn: 会后我将第一时间把详尽规范的会议纪要以及云端录播回放链接群发各位。

sentences.sentence_en: Please review the notes and reply with any corrections by tomorrow noon.
sentences.sentence_cn: 请诸位抽空核实纪要内容，若有任何遗漏或纰漏偏差，请于明日正午之前回信指出。

sentences.sentence_en: This has been an extraordinarily productive session, great collaboration team!
sentences.sentence_cn: 今天这场会议的产出效率堪称非凡卓越，感谢大家展现出的绝佳团队协作！

sentences.sentence_en: Thank you all for your active participation and tremendous contributions.
sentences.sentence_cn: 由衷感谢各位全程的全情投入、踊跃参与以及所贡献的诸多非凡洞见。

sentences.sentence_en: Have a wonderful rest of your day, talk to you all again next Tuesday.
sentences.sentence_cn: 祝各位度过充实愉快的一天，下周二同一时间我们线上再会！

sentences.sentence_en: I am going to end the meeting room for everyone now, goodbye!
sentences.sentence_cn: 我现在将正式为全体参会人员结束并关闭本次视频线上会议室，大家再见！

sentences.sentence_en: Thanks everyone, take care and stay safe!
sentences.sentence_cn: 多谢各位同仁，祝大家诸事顺遂，保重身体！

sentences.sentence_en: Welcome to Shanghai, Mr. Thompson! Did you have a pleasant flight?
sentences.sentence_cn: 热烈欢迎您莅临上海，汤普森先生！您一路航程还算舒适顺畅吗？

sentences.sentence_en: Allow our driver to take care of your heavy suitcases for you.
sentences.sentence_cn: 请让我们专职的商务礼宾司机来为您搬运照料这些沉重的行李箱吧。

sentences.sentence_en: We have arranged a comfortable business van to transfer you to your hotel.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们已为您精心安排了一辆宽敞舒适的豪华商务座驾，直达您下榻的酒店。

sentences.sentence_en: The ride to the city center takes around forty-five minutes under current traffic.
sentences.sentence_cn: 按照当前路况测算，从机场前往市中心核心商务区车程大约需要四十五分钟。

sentences.sentence_en: It is an immense privilege to host your esteemed executive delegation today.
sentences.sentence_cn: 今天能有幸在我们公司总部迎候贵司资深高管代表团一行，实乃我司无上荣光。

sentences.sentence_en: Please step into our VIP reception room, would you care for hot tea or espresso?
sentences.sentence_cn: 请移步前往我们的贵宾接待室就座，请问您想品尝一下热茗还是意式浓缩咖啡？

sentences.sentence_en: Our CEO, Mr. Zhang, will join us shortly to personally extend his welcome.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们集团首席执行官张总稍后便会亲临现场，亲自向各位表达热烈诚挚的欢迎。

sentences.sentence_en: Here is today's printed itinerary outlining our presentations and factory tour.
sentences.sentence_cn: 这是一份印制精美的今日日程安排表，清晰罗列了高层汇报与实地考察环节。

sentences.sentence_en: Follow me, please. This interactive exhibition hall showcases our corporate history.
sentences.sentence_cn: 请随我这边走。这座数字化互动展厅生动展现了我们企业波澜壮阔的发展历程。

sentences.sentence_en: Over here is our central R&D laboratory where new prototypes are tested.
sentences.sentence_cn: 这边是我们核心的中央研发实验室，所有尖端初代原型样机均在此接受极限测试。

sentences.sentence_en: We currently employ over three hundred talented engineers on this campus.
sentences.sentence_cn: 在这片现代化科技园区内，我们汇聚了三百多位极具才华的资深顶尖研发工程师。

sentences.sentence_en: Feel free to stop me and ask questions at any stage along the tour.
sentences.sentence_cn: 在整个参观过程中，您若有任何好奇与疑问，请随时打断我向我提问。

sentences.sentence_en: Is this your first time visiting China, or have you been here before?
sentences.sentence_cn: 请问这是您生平第一次到访中国，还是此前曾有过在华旅行或经商的经历？

sentences.sentence_en: Have you had a chance to try authentic local cuisines like soup dumplings?
sentences.sentence_cn: 您此前曾有机会品尝过像正宗南翔小笼包这样名扬四海的本地传统名点吗？

sentences.sentence_en: The autumn weather here is usually wonderfully crisp and mild.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们这里的金秋时节，天气通常都是这般秋高气爽、怡人舒适、沁人心脾。

sentences.sentence_en: We hope your stay here proves to be both productive and culturally enriching.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们由衷期盼您此番商务行程既能成果斐然，又能领略丰富厚重的文化底蕴。

sentences.sentence_en: Please take the seat of honor facing the entrance with the garden view.
sentences.sentence_cn: 请您在正对大门、背靠典雅园林景观的主宾尊位上就座。

sentences.sentence_en: We have pre-ordered a banquet featuring delicate Cantonese specialties.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们已提前为各位精心遴选并预订了一席极具特色的正宗精致粤菜盛宴。

sentences.sentence_en: Are there any dietary preferences or ingredients your team would like to avoid?
sentences.sentence_cn: 贵司团队同仁在饮食方面是否有特定的偏好忌口，或有哪些食材需要避开？
